title: Getting CE certified ｜ Aquaksky
excerptHtml:
Getting CE certified ｜ Aquaksky

Aquasky has updated the CE certification to the latest version, 2014/68/EU(PED) by TÜV Rheinl, and the QA-Modules E1, E, D1, D are covered by Module H. Our certification number is 01 202 TWIN/Q-19 0360.

bodyHtml:
Aquasky has updated the CE certification to the latest version, 2014/68/EU(PED) by TÜV Rheinl and the QA-Modules E1, E, D1, D are covered by Module H. Our certification number is 01 202 TWIN/Q-19 0360.
Aquasky has the permission to affix the CE marking to pressure equipment described and manufactured in accordance to the scope covered by Quality-Assurance System: CE0035 QA-System (Module H).
